ideas.pitch: A real-time multiplayer code-dueling platform where two participants solve algorithmic problems simultaneously on a shared canvas with live syntax-aware diffing and automated test-case generation.
ideas.title: AlgoDuet: Collaborative Competitive Programming Arena
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the competitive programming and algorithmic problem-solving core of CodeVerse by enhancing the participant experience beyond standard platforms.

ideas.pitch: A static analysis tool that parses submitted source code in Python, C++, or Java, constructs abstract syntax trees, and dynamically estimates both Time and Space complexity while flagging potential TLE bottlenecks.
ideas.title: ComplexityLens: Automated Algorithmic Complexity Analyzer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves a core problem for competitive programmers during rapid trial-and-error testing phases, appealing directly to the judges' background in data structures and algorithms.

ideas.pitch: An educational debugging plugin that hooks into competitive programming execution runs to render real-time graphical representations of pointers, trees, graphs, and heap structures in memory.
ideas.title: DataStructViz: Interactive Memory Layout Visualizer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the hackathon's focus on data structures and algorithms by providing a high-utility visualization tool for complex pointer manipulations.

ideas.pitch: An LLM-assisted tool that takes a competitive programming problem statement and automatically generates tricky edge cases, maximum constraints, and stress-testing scripts to break naive solutions.
ideas.title: TestGenie: AI Edge-Case Generator for CP
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines algorithmic problem understanding with practical developer tooling, echoing the technical problem-solving spirit required in the 90-minute coding round.

ideas.pitch: A recommendation engine that analyzes a competitive programmer's past submission history and weak spots across arrays, sorting, and graph algorithms to dynamically curate an optimal practice path.
ideas.title: CP-Route: Optimal Problem Selection Engine
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses strictly on logical thinking and algorithmic proficiency tracking, aligning with the evaluation metrics of the competition.
